full_judgment: 4. The Assistant Judge, Borhanuddin Upazila heard arguments from both the sides, discussed the evidence and believed that the plaintiffs have been able to prove their case. So, the trial Court decreed the suit for eviction of defendant Nos. 1 and 2 from the suit property and for khas possession and also for permanent injunction.
